items.headline: March NAC feature (large): the national youth event in Atlantic City
items.body: CARRIED for No. 8 (large feature). Frank wants a much larger article next week: the March NAC is for basically all the kids at our club, and he will highly encourage everyone to go since it's 'local' (Atlantic City). Facts collected from the official event page are in `facts`; re-fetch the page before writing (the event schedule was not posted yet, and the withdrawal/refund deadline is inconsistent on the page). Angles: who is eligible (Y10/Y12/Y14/Div II, all weapons; check the Athlete Handbook), what a NAC is versus RYC/SYC, dates and the Jan. 6 regular-fee deadline with fees, late fees (triple), no-show fine, parking/hotels, free spectator admission.
items.vet_scope: Frank chat t231u: topic and angle vetted; write from official facts only.
items.frank_direction: Today we'll keep it short, next week we will have a much larger article because March NAC is for basically all the kids at our club. I will highly encourage everyone to go esp since it's "local".

facts.event: 2027 March North American Cup (March NAC), USA Fencing national event
facts.categories: Y14, Y12, Y10 and Division II; epee, foil and saber
facts.venue: Atlantic City Convention Center, 1 Convention Blvd., Atlantic City, NJ 08401 (exhibit hall TBD)
facts.late_entry_deadline: 5 p.m. local time the night before the event
facts.withdrawal_deadline: Feb. 3, 2027 for a 50% event-fee refund (the Withdrawals section of the same page says the refund deadline is TBD, 11:59 p.m. Pacific — conflicting; confirm before printing)
facts.no_show: $250 per event fine plus suspension of membership privileges until paid, for not appearing without notice by 5 p.m. local the day before
facts.refunds: tournament and administration fees nonrefundable; 50% event-fee refunds processed 4–6 weeks after the tournament
facts.parking: see convention center website; USA Fencing partner SpotHero
facts.schedule: Event Schedule section was empty when fetched (no per-day event list yet)
